name: Material+
author: Zoidium
description: Adds Matcap, Node Material, Image+, physically based, and corrected-UV material extensions.

materialTypes.name: Matcap Material
materialTypes.description: Applies a view-dependent Matcap texture to a 3D object.

materialTypes.name: PBR+ Material
materialTypes.description: Applies a physically based material with texture maps for surface properties.

materialTypes.name: UV Custom Material
materialTypes.description: Like Custom Material, with evenly spaced texture UVs on 3D Text and extruded shapes.

materialTypes.name: Node Material
materialTypes.description: Bakes procedural node graphs into physically based surface maps.

materialTypes.name: Image+ Material
materialTypes.description: Image material with animated opacity and transparency.
